name: bugasura
description: Bug tracking and test management in Bugasura: issues, test cases, sprints, test runs, requirements, knowledge base and TestPert AI test generation.

interface.longDescription: Bugasura is a bug tracking and test management tool for software and QA teams. This plugin connects your Bugasura workspace to ChatGPT and Codex: log and update bugs, assign and comment on them; write, run and report test cases; plan sprints and test runs; manage requirements and link them to test cases; keep a project knowledge base; and generate test cases from requirements with TestPert. Refer to teams, projects and issues by name or key (such as ISS09); Bugasura resolves them for you. You sign in with your own Bugasura account, and every action runs with your permissions.
defaultPrompt: List my Bugasura teams and projects
Show the latest issues in my project
Create a test case for the login flow
